title: Formula One (F1) - All Laps & Telemetry Dataset
subtitle: ML-ready lap level dataset - All drivers, cars, tracks & telemetry (2026)
description:
# Formula 1 2026 Lap History (Live Dataset)

## Latest Updates
29.03 - Japan
08.03 - Australia
15.03 - China
3.05 - Miami
24.05 - Canada
12.09 - Incremental All Laps refresh

## About
Every lap. Every driver. Every data point — from Bahrain Pre-Season Testing through to the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

This dataset covers the full 2026 Formula One season, beginning with Pre-Season Testing Day 1 on 11 February 2026 and updated continuously through to the final lap of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix on 6 December 2026.

All data has been sourced programmatically using a combination of APIs, then cleaned, enriched, and validated so you can go straight to analysis — no preprocessing required.

## Who Is This For?

This dataset is purpose-built for beginner to intermediate data analysts and machine learning enthusiasts who want to work with real, rich motorsport data without the usual data-wrangling overhead.

## What's included?

- All drivers
- All 2026 laps to date
- Lap time (formatted and numeric)
- Tyre compound and tyre age
- Telemetry (speed, throttle, brake, gear, RPM, DRS)
- XYZ location coordinates

Telemetry and coordinates are provided in 0.5 second / 2 Hz intervals.

One row = one lap. The `telemetry` column is a JSON array of samples for that lap.

Starter notebook: **f1-all-laps-starter** (load, profile, plot).

Pre-season testing is also available as a separate file on earlier versions.
